name: proxy-kiro
description: Kiro Proxy — multi-provider AI gateway with Claude, OpenAI and Responses compatible endpoints
comment_no_dependencies: Intentionally zero runtime deps: the package is a launcher for a self-contained Go binary. Spinner, free-port scan and browser-open are ~40 lines of node stdlib each, and every dependency here is one more thing that can break a global install behind a corporate proxy.
comment_binary: The Go binary is NOT bundled in the tarball (it is ~22MB x 6 platforms). hooks/postinstall.js downloads the one matching this machine from the GitHub release for this version into ~/.kiroproxy/bin, verified against SHA256SUMS. cli.js re-checks and re-downloads at startup, so a failed/offline postinstall self-heals.
